external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app and kiosks to borrow, renew, reserve, and return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who use the circulation page to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books as returned.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page; the password is on a card taped under the desk.

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: A mobile app through which members borrow, renew, and reserve books.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API that is the service interface for loan operations and the only component stated to read or write the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Authentication is unverified: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." Exposure is disputed: Lending service note says "The lending API is internal-only"; Interview transcript says, "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet."

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where a member scans their library card and books being borrowed or returned, then sends loan and return information to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
processes.notes: The source does not establish what the kiosks talk to apart from what arrives at the API.

processes.name: Circulation page
processes.description: The page used by desk staff to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books as returned by hand.
processes.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account
processes.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page. The password is on a card taped under the desk.

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses, and members' full borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: Priya corrected the earlier statement about two databases: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: borrow renew reserve
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew, or reserve a book.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Book and member details, and borrow, renewal, or reservation requests.

data_flows.name: request loan change
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API with a book and member for borrowing, renewing, or reserving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: The API's authentication behavior is unknown; Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."
data_flows.data_description: Book and member details, plus a loan renewal, borrowing, or reservation request.

data_flows.name: send loan return
data_flows.description: A self-service kiosk sends each loan and return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: A member card, book, loan, or return transaction.

data_flows.name: manage loan account
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page to extend a loan, clear a block, or mark a book as returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: All desk staff use the same shared login; the history records that a loan was closed by hand but cannot identify the person or branch.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and member-account changes, using the shared circulation-page credential.

data_flows.name: update loan record
data_flows.description: The circulation page sends desk-staff loan and account changes to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The page is served by the lending API; the source does not state the transport or authentication exchange between the page and API beyond the shared desk login.
data_flows.data_description: Loan extensions, account-block changes, and hand-entered returns.

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations, and member contact and borrowing-history records.

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and members' full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database."
